title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer who is passionate about pixel-perfect implementation, complex CSS/JS interactions, and rendering speeds. You will lead the development of our client-facing web applications and build beautiful, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces.
requirements: 5+ years of experience building modern web applications with React, Vue, or modern frontend tools
Deep expertise in CSS3, CSS Modules, Flexbox, Grid, and standard web APIs
Proven track record of optimizing Core Web Vitals and achieving Lighthouse scores >90
Experience with state management, animations (e.g. Framer Motion, GSAP, or Web Animations API), and SVG manipulation
responsibilities: Develop clean, modular, and reusable UI components and page layouts
Collaborate with product designers to implement premium interactions and micro-animations
Audit and resolve performance bottlenecks in frontend rendering pipelines
Mentor junior developers and participate in code reviews to maintain high quality standards

title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description: We are looking for a Lead UI/UX Designer who can bridge the gap between human behaviors and stunning technology. You will define the visual style, user journey, and design systems for enterprise-grade applications, producing high-fidelity prototypes and final specifications.
requirements: 6+ years of UI/UX design experience, preferably in agency or B2B SaaS spaces
Expert knowledge of Figma, design systems, and visual asset generation
Strong portfolio demonstrating minimalist layouts, clean grids, and rich typography
Ability to articulate design rationale and present user test findings to stakeholders
responsibilities: Own the end-to-end design process, from low-fidelity wireframes to polished responsive mocks
Maintain, document, and expand our corporate design token system
Conduct user research, mapping sessions, and prototype usability testing
Provide developers with clean specs, SVGs, and transition instructions

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description: We need a Cloud Solutions Architect to design scalable, secure, and cost-effective multi-region cloud infrastructures on GCP/AWS. You will build automation scripts, configure Kubernetes routing, and establish self-healing server architectures.
requirements: 4+ years as a Cloud Solutions Architect with AWS or Google Cloud certifications
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE)
Deep understanding of distributed systems, CDN edge routing, caching strategies, and database clustering
Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
responsibilities: Design multi-region cloud architectures that support auto-scaling and high availability
Write declarative Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates using Terraform
Collaborate with security teams to ensure SOC2 and GDPR compliance across cloud assets
Optimize server configurations to reduce compute costs and resource waste
